name: Simple Custom Code – Custom CSS, JS, and HTML, Visual CSS Customizer
author: AppsCreo

sections.description:
Simple Custom Code – CSS, JS, and HTML lets you add custom CSS, JavaScript, and HTML to WordPress without touching theme files. Create and manage unlimited code snippets in one place. Every snippet is saved as a file in your uploads folder, so your code loads fast, caches well, and stays portable — no database clutter.

Choose the workflow that fits you. The live Visual CSS Customizer lets you point at any element on your page, click to select it, and style it with real-time visual controls. Or write code directly in the built-in editor with syntax highlighting, autocomplete, and error checking. Both paths produce clean, ready-to-use code.

Free features include:

  • Unlimited CSS, JavaScript, and HTML snippets
  • File-based storage for better performance and caching
  • Live Visual CSS Customizer with real-time preview
  • Gravity Forms Visual CSS Customizer
  • Code editor with syntax highlighting and autocomplete
  • Code beautifier and error detection
  • AI code generation using your own OpenAI API key
  • Load snippets on the frontend, admin, login page, or block editor
  • Control load position and priority per snippet
  • Role-based access control
  • Snippet descriptions and groups
  • Smart tags: page title, featured image, permalink
  • Basic snippet health check
  • See which snippets load on each page — view loaded snippets directly on your site
  • Import and export single snippets or all snippets
  • Import snippets from WPCode, Code Snippets, Header Footer Code Manager, and Simple Custom CSS and JS

Live Visual CSS Customizer

Create designs directly from your site’s frontend using the built-in Visual CSS Editor. Select any element visually, adjust fonts, colors, spacing, borders, and hover effects with live preview, and save when you are happy with the result.

Key features:

  • Launch the CSS Customizer from the admin bar with one click
  • Select elements visually without writing selectors
  • Adjust fonts, colors, spacing, borders, transitions, and hover effects
  • See changes in real time before saving
  • Every visual change generates clean, optimized CSS

Gravity Forms Visual CSS Customizer

Style Gravity Forms with the dedicated live CSS customizer. Open it from the admin bar under CSS Customize > Gravity Forms and fine-tune form fields, labels, buttons, and layouts in real time. Match your forms to your brand without writing CSS by hand.

Unlimited CSS, JavaScript & HTML Snippets

Go beyond CSS. Create and manage unlimited snippets for CSS, JavaScript, and HTML from a single interface. Each snippet type is built for its purpose, so you can style, script, and structure your site exactly as you need.

Highlights:

  • Create as many snippets as you need for CSS, JS, or HTML
  • All snippets saved as external files for better caching and portability
  • Activate or deactivate snippets anytime
  • Load externally or inline
  • Choose code position: head, after body, or footer
  • Set priority levels to control load order
  • Rename snippet files for better organization

Flexible Loading Locations

Control where your code loads. Unlike basic custom CSS plugins, Simple Custom Code gives you granular control over the context and location of each snippet:

  • Frontend: load CSS, JS, or HTML on the public-facing side of your site
  • Backend: inject code into the WordPress admin dashboard
  • Login Page: target the WordPress login screen for branded login pages
  • Block Editor: load code inside the Gutenberg block editor

You never load unnecessary code where it does not belong, keeping your site lean and fast.

Advanced Code Editor with Autocomplete & Syntax Highlighting

The built-in code editor is built for developers and beginners alike:

  • Syntax highlighting: CSS, JavaScript, and HTML are color-coded for easy reading
  • Real-time autocomplete: the editor suggests CSS properties, JavaScript functions, and WordPress hooks as you type
  • Code beautifier: format messy code with one click
  • Error detection: flags syntax issues before you save, so mistakes never reach your site

AI-Powered Code Generation

Describe what you need in plain English, and the AI generates ready-to-use CSS, JavaScript, or HTML. Whether it is a sticky header, a custom button style, or an admin tweak, tell the AI what you need and review the result in the editor before saving.

  • Works with CSS, JavaScript, and HTML snippets
  • Uses your own OpenAI API key, so you control your API usage and costs
  • Generated code inserts directly into the editor for review and adjustment

Smart Plugin Settings

Total control over how and where your snippets load:

  • Role-based access control: limit editor access to specific WordPress roles
  • Cache-busting file versions: browsers always load the most recent changes
  • Inline or external loading per snippet
  • Adjust snippet priority, file naming, and execution location from the settings page

See Loaded Snippets on the Page

Check exactly which snippets are active on any page. The plugin lists the loaded snippets directly on your site so you can verify what is running, where, and in what order — without guessing or hunting through the admin.

Upgrade to Pro

The free version covers the essentials. The Pro upgrade adds advanced features for developers and agencies who need complete control over code delivery:

  • Conditional loading: target snippets by URL, post type, user role, date, or WooCommerce cart and page conditions
  • Version history: save a snapshot of every snippet change, compare versions side by side, and restore with one click
  • Code minification: automatically minify CSS and JavaScript on save
  • SCSS and Less compiler: write styles in SCSS or Less and compile to CSS automatically
  • Reusable snippets: include one snippet inside another with {{include:ID}} or the [reusable_snippet] shortcode
  • Expanded smart tags: user details, WooCommerce product and order data, ACF fields, dates, UTM parameters, and more
  • WooCommerce positions: load code on cart, checkout, product, shop, and thank-you pages
  • Cache mode: combine active snippets into a single cached file per page
  • Priority technical support

Pro is built for performance-focused developers and agencies who need production-grade code management on WordPress. Learn more and upgrade at simplecustomcode.com

Who This Is For

This plugin helps anyone customize WordPress design and functionality quickly, safely, and without touching core files:

  • Web developers who want full control over styling and scripting without modifying theme files
  • Designers who use the Visual CSS Customizer to fine-tune typography, colors, and layouts without code
  • Site owners who make small design adjustments or add scripts without hiring a developer
  • Agencies and freelancers who manage multiple client sites and store custom code snippets efficiently

* WordPress beginners who learn CSS and JavaScript using visual controls, AI assistance, and instant preview
sections.installation:
Method 1: WordPress Dashboard (Recommended)

  1. Navigate to Plugins → Add New in your WordPress admin.
  2. Click the Upload Plugin button at the top of the page.
  3. Choose the appscreo-visual-css-customizer.zip file from your computer.
  4. Click Install Now and wait for the installation to complete.
  5. Click Activate Plugin.

Method 2: Manual FTP Upload

  1. Unzip the appscreo-visual-css-customizer.zip file to your computer.
  2. Upload the appscreo-visual-css-customizer folder to /wp-content/plugins/ on your server.
  3. Navigate to Plugins in your WordPress admin dashboard.
  4. Find “Simple Custom Code – CSS, JS, and HTML” in the plugin list and click Activate.

First-Time Setup

  1. After activation, you’ll see a Custom Code menu item in your WordPress admin.
  2. Click Custom Code → Add New to create your first snippet.
  3. Visit any page on your site’s frontend and click the CSS Customize button in the admin toolbar to launch the visual customizer, or start directly from the snippet editor.
sections.faq:
Can I use the Visual Customizer on any theme?

The customizer works on most modern, well-coded themes. It may have limited functionality on themes that:
– Heavily rely on JavaScript for rendering their layout
– Use excessive iframes or shadow DOM elements
– Have complex, non-standard DOM structures

For best results, we recommend using it with block themes (WordPress 5.9+) or classic themes with standard HTML structure.

Is it safe to use on a live site?

Absolutely! You have full control:
1. Create and test snippets while they are set to “Inactive”
2. The visual customizer shows a live preview, but changes are only saved when you explicitly click “Save Snippet”
3. Even after saving, snippets won’t affect your live site until you change their status to “Active”
4. You can use URL conditions to test snippets on specific pages before applying site-wide

Can I use this alongside other CSS plugins?

Yes, but be mindful of potential conflicts. Simple Custom Code – CSS, JS, and HTML loads after most theme styles but before other plugins. Use the Priority setting to adjust load order if needed.

I’m upgrading from a version prior to 1.3 — where did the “CSS Modifications” menu go?

In version 1.3, the CSS Modifications admin menu item has been renamed to Custom Code. This reflects the expanded capabilities of the plugin, which now supports CSS, JavaScript, and HTML snippets — not just CSS. All of your existing custom CSS snippets, settings, and configurations are fully preserved and will continue to work exactly as before. Nothing is lost — the menu has simply been renamed to better represent what the plugin can now do.

Can I use the AI code generation feature?

Yes! AI-powered code generation is available in the free version. You’ll need to provide your own OpenAI API key, which you can obtain from your OpenAI account. Once configured in the plugin settings, simply describe what you want in plain English and the AI will generate the appropriate CSS, JavaScript, or HTML code for you.

Does the plugin slow down my site?

No — performance is a core design principle. All snippets are stored as external files (not in the database), which means they benefit from browser and server-side caching. You can also choose between inline or external loading per snippet, and use priority settings to ensure optimal load order. Pro users gain additional performance tools including minification, async loading, and cache mode.

What’s the difference between the free version and Pro?

The free version includes all the core features: unlimited CSS, JS, and HTML snippets, the Visual CSS Customizer, file-based storage, the advanced code editor, AI-powered generation, loading location control, and role-based access. Pro adds developer-grade performance tools: conditional loading by URL, JS defer, async CSS, SCSS/Less compilation, auto-minification, cache mode, and priority support.

Will upgrading to Pro affect my existing snippets?

Not at all. Upgrading to Pro is seamless — all your snippets and settings remain fully intact.
sections.changelog:
2.0

  • Updated and improved the plugin UI
  • Updated OpenAI connector with support for new models
  • Added AI connectors for Claude, DeepSeek, and OpenRouter
  • Added snippet descriptions option
  • Added groups to organize snippets
  • Added smart tags inside snippets. Free smart tags: page title, featured image, permalink
  • Added basic snippet health check
  • Added loaded snippets view — see which snippets load on each page directly on your site
  • Added import and export for single snippets or all snippets
  • Added snippets import from WPCode, Code Snippets, Header Footer Code Manager, and Simple Custom CSS and JS. Only snippets supported by this plugin can be imported.

1.4

  • Updated OpenAI code generation models to support the latest GPT-5.5 model.
  • Added manual display support with shortcodes for all snippet types.
  • Added a device targeting option for HTML snippets, allowing display on desktop or mobile devices only.
  • Added support for processing shortcodes inside HTML snippet content, including shortcodes from other plugins and Simple Custom Code.

1.3

  • Plugin Renamed & Expanded: Simple Visual CSS Customizer is now Simple Custom Code – CSS, JS, and HTML, reflecting full support for CSS, JavaScript, and HTML snippets — not just CSS.
  • Menu Renamed: The admin menu item “CSS Modifications” has been renamed to Custom Code to reflect the plugin’s expanded capabilities. All existing snippets and settings are preserved.
  • Added unlimited JavaScript snippets with full editor support.
  • Added unlimited HTML snippets with full editor support.
  • Added new loading locations: Frontend, Backend (wp-admin), Login page, and Block Editor.
  • Added real-time code autocomplete for CSS, JS, and HTML with WordPress hooks.
  • Added built-in code beautifier for one-click formatting.
  • Added syntax highlighting for CSS, JavaScript, and HTML.
  • Added smart error detection and validation for cleaner, safer code.
  • Added role-based access control to restrict snippet management by WordPress user role.
  • Added AI-powered code generation (requires your own OpenAI API key) — describe what you need in plain English, get ready-to-use CSS, JS, or HTML.

1.2 (Simple Custom Code base)

  • Added Visual CSS Customizer for real-time visual styling.

1.1

  • Added Gravity Forms CSS live visual front-end customizer under “CSS Customize” → Gravity Forms in admin bar.
  • Increased editor height to utilize full screen height.
  • Added option to enable file versioning for externally loaded files.
  • Added option to load code right after the body opening tag.

1.0

  • Initial public release of Simple Visual CSS Customizer (now Simple Custom Code – CSS, JS, and HTML).
  • Live visual front-end customizer with “CSS Customize” admin bar entry.
  • File-based CSS storage system to prevent database bloat.
  • Advanced snippet controls: loading positions, URL conditions, priorities.
  • Complete settings panel with role-based access control.
